shared_objects:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Purpose: fair visual art-direction exploration for a playable third-person 3D game called Zhouzhu, rural ancient East Asian floating-island shipping and village life, not a finished asset. All objects must be physically coherent and achievable as real-time 3D models. Specific historical region and dynasty are deliberately undecided. Absolutely no image text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, callouts, UI, inset pictures.
LOCKED OBJECTS FOR ALL DIRECTIONS:
One young adult East Asian male working boatman, age about 22, dark hair tied in a small practical bun, no beard; faded indigo wrap-front hip-length work jacket with forearms exposed, undyed hemp trousers, brown cloth sash, straw sandals. No weapons, jewellery, noble costume, embroidered motifs or backpack.
One modest open-deck wooden sailing airboat, length 7.5 m beam 2.6 m, shallow cargo hull, single 4.5 m mast, one plain undyed rectangular battened cloth sail with five horizontal battens, simple working ropes, low stern steering position and a flat open central cargo space, one covered opaque floatstone compartment integrated BELOW the deck. No balloon, wings, engines, glowing energy, hanging giant rocks, crystals, figurehead, pennants or elaborate ornament.
One ordinary single-storey 6 by 5 m rural house: warm ochre rammed-earth wall infill, visible dark timber frame, plain grey clay-tile gable roof with only a very slight eave lift, door about 2.1 m high and one square wooden lattice window on the facade, low stone footing, simple two-step threshold. Eaves about 2.6 m, roof ridge about 4 m. No palace, temple, pagoda or elaborate roof silhouette.
Small props: plain plank wooden cargo chest with wooden battens, squat reddish-brown unglazed pottery jar with a narrow mouth and two small side lugs, compact functional stone axe with dark grey ground stone head lashed to a wooden handle, foxtail millet (Setaria italica) with dense nodding golden cylindrical seedheads and a small pile of tiny round grain, and a palm-sized opaque charcoal-grey irregular floatstone with muted mineral inclusions, no transparency, no emission, no levitation display and no runes.
Keep utility and modest material resources consistent. Earth, weathered wood, stone, grey tile, rough pottery, hemp cloth, straw; small restrained lacquer details only if needed, no ornament. Colors have the same identities in every style: warm earth, dark wood, grey roof, indigo clothing, offwhite sail, muted greens, pale blue sky.
Lighting is always fair weather about 10 AM, soft sunlight from upper left with open blue skylight, gentle haze, readable moderately soft shadows, neutral exposure. No dramatic sunset, god rays, epic storm, heavy depth-of-field, cinematic color grading or magical effects.
scene_layout:
Asset type: landscape scene concept, one image, approximately 1536x1024, 3:2.
Scene and camera are LOCKED: a very small working port at the edge of one floating island, viewed from the dirt approach at a third-person-like eye height about 1.7 m, natural 35 mm perspective, level horizon in upper third. NOT an aerial view, not isometric, not a cutout diorama. Wide enough to read people, house and entire airboat together, including mast and sail.
The house is at middle LEFT, facade and right wall visible. A plain rectangular timber quay and docking cradle of about 9 by 5 m is at middle RIGHT, firmly connected to the island rim. The one airboat rests alongside in that cradle over open air, bow toward lower-right, stern near center, deck at quay height, one short narrow gangplank connects quay to deck. Cradle brackets attach to the nearby solid rock; do not send piles down into clouds. Two plain mooring posts, simple taut mooring lines. Show an intelligible clear walking path from doorway to gangplank.
The boatman is at lower LEFT foreground seen three-quarter from behind looking toward his boat, full body. Exactly three other ordinary villagers: one dockworker near the gangplank, one worker beside the doorway, one elder seated by the house. Keep people visible and in consistent physical scale. Three plain wooden cargo chests and four hemp sacks gathered beside the path, one pottery jar by the threshold. Modest patches of grass, no decorative clutter.
On RIGHT and in background, cloud sea below with exactly three quiet, comparably modest distant floating islands: ordinary earth-and-grass tops, chunky weathered rock undersides, softly receding atmospheric values. The visible near cliff edge is safe to read but not turned into a spectacle. Clouds are CLOUDS, not an ocean or river; there is no water beneath the boat. No waterfalls, huge peaks, monumental island needles, extra villages or extra boats.

styles.A: STYLE A — grounded natural stylized real-time 3D. Clearly three-dimensional rendered models with moderate polygon economy and selectively faceted large rock and wood forms. Human proportions about 6.5 heads tall, workmanlike and expressive but adult, not chibi. Clear silhouettes, solid planes, gently softened hand-contact edges, sparse hand-painted low-frequency surface variation. Desaturate slightly without making everything beige. Distinguish earth, wood, cloth and clay through shape and roughness, never photoreal microtexture. Physically understandable broad diffuse lighting, grounded contact shadows. Avoid toy plastic, glossy clay, extreme low-poly triangles and generic mobile cartoon. Organic landscape geometry can be smooth where necessary; do not force all faces flat.
styles.B: STYLE B — picture-book-like HAND-PAINTED THREE-DIMENSIONAL real-time game world. Fully modelled solid 3D volumes with stable perspective and real working geometry. Intentional expressive proportions: boatman about 5.5 heads tall, slightly larger hands and head, adult not baby. Simplify objects into broad gently irregular masses and slightly rounded silhouettes. Confident grouped color patches, visible sparse gouache-like broad strokes IN THE SURFACE TEXTURES, warm earth and muted indigo with cool soft blue-grey shade. Simplify tile groupings, wood planes and foliage without changing house dimensions, roof type, ship dimensions or features. Gentle tonal steps and softer shadow edges, no black outlines. Charming but hardworking and modest, not whimsical magical fantasy. No flat 2D watercolor illustration, paper collage, impossible painted lighting, distorted architecture or extra cute ornaments.
styles.C: STYLE C — restrained SIMPLIFIED REALISM for a practical real-time 3D game. Credible adult human proportions about 7.5 heads tall, realistic hands and face but economical game-ready geometry, same character and clothes. Structurally true house, vessel and tools. Natural coarse material expression: directional wood grain, rammed-earth compaction, cloth weave at an appropriate scale, rough clay, stone fractures, gentle controlled edge wear exactly where touched or exposed, limited grime. Muted natural colors retaining the locked color identities; soft physically based daylight and modest reflectance. Keep large surfaces readable, broad clean lighting and low visual noise. No photogrammetry-level detail, hyperreal pores, distressed ruin, muddy dark grading, expensive cinematic rendering, more elaborate assets or more impressive terrain.
